title: Pumpkin and Butternut Quiche
subtitle: with a wholemeal spelt coconut oil crust
description: A quiche of roasted pumpkin and butternut squash in a creamy egg filling, with a wholemeal spelt crust made with coconut oil.

ingredients.name: Mixed Pumpkin, Sunflower and Sesame Seeds

steps.text: Make the crust: mix the flour and sea salt in a bowl, add the chilled coconut oil and mix until the dough has a sandy texture.
Add the cold water gradually, one tablespoon at a time, mixing (a food processor works) only until a non-sticky dough forms. Wrap in cling film, roll out to a 1 cm round and chill for 15 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 150°C. Roll the dough to 0.5 cm thick, line a quiche tin greased with coconut oil, and prick the base with a fork. Blind bake for 10 to 15 minutes until lightly golden.
Increase the oven to 200°C. Toss the thinly sliced pumpkin and butternut with coconut oil, salt and pepper, spread on a baking tray lined with baking paper and roast for 10 minutes.
Whisk the eggs with the cream until smooth, then whisk in the flour, crushed garlic, sea salt and pepper until lump-free.
Pour the filling into the crust, arrange the roasted vegetables on top and scatter over the seeds.
Bake for about 30 minutes until the filling is set. Serve warm or lightly reheated.
